title: A harmony (chord symbol) on a global measure is rejected
description: MNX has no harmony concept anywhere: no root, no kind, no chord symbol — the single most ubiquitous marking in guitar, jazz and pop notation. This document writes a minimal structured harmony (root + kind at a rhythmic position) on the global measure, parallel to how tempos already work, and pins the rejection: the global measure refuses unevaluated properties. The workaround is the _x.mnxLab.harmonies vendor block, shaped exactly like this exhibit so adoption deletes the wrapper.
